header.about: Quicksilver's class melee share and Thief opportunist. kind share: [min, max] after the engine's class_melee_pct for a class (1 Warrior to 15 Mystic; others unscaled) at a level. kind fighter: [lowest, highest] damage of a landed non-critical blow with no damage reduction, through the engine's fighter builder and blow resolution for a player (Strength 50, a weapon of the given damage; martial-arts moves use skill as the move's level and ma_dmg as its damage ability; plus_max is Alter Max Damage). kind opening: [bonus low, bonus high, sum of the bonus damage over every percentile roll and every damage roll, number of rolls]; dr is the target's damage reduction in MME's units; mean = sum / rolls. v120 is the 1.20.0 balance; neutral has class shares 100, no opportunist and stock stab keys; alt is an off-grid balance (see balance_keys; class_melee_pct under alt: Warrior anchors 10:80 30:135 50:90, Thief anchors 5:120 45:33, Mage 37, Ranger anchors 1:10 2:11 3:13 90:250, every other class 101).
